notes.title: Last update before release!
notes.content:
Here are bugs and issues fixed during the last testing.

- Updated NW.js from version 0.30.0 to version 0.32.0.
- Now when the player boots the game and enters in the main menu, stage selection will follow the player progression. 
- Fixed some error in english/french text. 
- Reduced volume level of the Sword Girl music theme. it was a bit too loud. 
- Fixed Time Girl triggering ''Speed boost'' on a ball that was about to purple explode. 
- Fixed red mini ball not triggering its effect properly when the white ball is on the platform or in the orange effect. 
- Destroying green sphere does not remove anymore the shield of the waiting girl or the power-up offered by the shower girl. 
- Fixed balls pushing the white ball in the orange effect. 
- Fixed yellow laser firing at shielded white ball. 
- Reduced difficulty of stages 94, 95 and 98.

If there's an issue, just head over the forum!

Hearty
